ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the message template. When it matches a stored message template, that message template is updated. Otherwise a new message template is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique template name shown in the composer picker.

Body.description: Text inserted into the composer when the template is picked.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the message template, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Templates.description: The message templates to create or update.
